Name: FortressCraft Chapter 1
Overview:
There's never been anything like FortressCraft on Xbox before now. A world of blocks that YOU create, on your own or online.

Playing as your Avatar, place blocks to shape the landscape around you. Build huts, houses, forts, castles, cathedrals, towers, mazes anything you can imagine. Find Relics - Boots of Speed, DestructoGun, FreezeRay and more!
